( #{item.taskid}, #{item.taskflow}, #{item.taskrule}, #{item.taskentityid}, #{item.taskclient},
#{item.taskproject}, #{item.taskcurrentactid}, #{item.taskpreactid}, #{item.taskuser}, #{item.tasksendtime},
#{item.taskname}, #{item.tasksenduser}, #{item.taskparenttaskid}, #{item.taskparentflowid}, #{item.taskparentactid},
#{item.taskcoordination}, #{item.taskstarttime}, #{item.taskendtime}, #{item.taskrb}, #{item.taskread},
#{item.taskreadtime}, #{item.tasksection}, #{item.taskcontract}, #{item.taskgetflagstr}, #{item.taskReturnType},

#{item.secId}, #{item.tCode} )
mapper.select:
select u.U_Name as sendUserName, du.C_ID as cId, du.U_Name as taskUserName, f.FileTitle as fileTitle, f.FileCode as fileCode, f.FileFlowStatus as fileflowstatus, f.FileCreateDate as filecreatedate, f.FileCreateUser as filecreateuser, f.FileCreateUserName as filecreateusername, f.FileProject as fileproject, f.T_Code as tCode,
from sys_task t left join SYS_User u on u.U_ID=t.TaskSendUser left join SYS_User du on du.U_ID=t.TaskUser left join SYS_File f on f.FileID=t.TaskEntityID left join sys_Task_Massage stm on t.TaskID = stm.task_Id where stm.id is null and du.U_Type = '2' and #{newDate}>TaskStartTime;
mapper.sql: t . TaskID as taskid, t.TaskFlow as taskflow, t.TaskRule as taskrule, t.TaskEntityID as taskentityid, t.TaskClient as taskclient, t.TaskProject as taskproject, t.TaskCurrentActID as taskcurrentactid, t.TaskPreActID taskpreactid, t.TaskUser as taskuser, t.TaskSendTime as tasksendtime, t.TaskName as taskname, t.TaskSendUser as tasksenduser, t.TaskParentTaskID as taskparenttaskid, t.TaskParentFlowID as taskparentflowid, t.TaskParentActID as taskparentactid, t.TaskCoordination as taskcoordination, t.TaskStartTime as taskstarttime, t.TaskEndTime as taskendtime, t.TaskRB as taskrb, t.TaskRead as taskread, t.TaskReadTime as taskreadtime, t.TaskSection as tasksection, t.TaskContract as taskcontract, t.TaskGetFlagstr as taskgetflagstr, t.Task_Return_Type as taskReturnType
mapper.select:
select mn.*, pp.p_name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, sec.Sec_Name as secName from SYS_File mn left join Pre_Project pp on pp.P_ID = mn.FileProject left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.FileContract left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.FileSectionID
order by mn.FileCreateDate desc
select distinct ${key} from SYS_File mn left join Pre_Project pp on pp.P_ID = mn.FileProject left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.FileContract
